inclusions: Pickup and drop-off from Deoghar Airport or Jasidih Railway Station.
Private air-conditioned vehicle for transfers and sightseeing.
Local transfers for temple visits and sightseeing as per the itinerary.

days.title: Day 1 - Arrival in Deoghar
activities: Pickup from Deoghar Airport or Jasidih Railway Station.
Transfer to the hotel and complete check-in.
Enjoy welcome refreshments and relax after the journey.
In the evening, explore the local markets at your own pace.
Dinner and overnight stay in Deoghar.

days.title: Day 2 - Baidyanath Jyotirlinga Darshan & Local Experiences
activities: Early morning visit to Baba Baidyanath Dham for darshan and prayers.
Visit the Shakti Peeth shrine within the temple complex.
Explore the temple surroundings and experience the spiritual atmosphere of Deoghar.
Visit a local shop to see the traditional preparation of Deoghar's famous peda sweets.
Attend the evening Aarti, subject to temple timings and arrangements.
Dinner and overnight stay in Deoghar.

days.title: Day 3 - Final Darshan & Departure
activities: Enjoy an optional second darshan or some last-minute souvenir shopping, depending on departure timings.
Transfer to Deoghar Airport or Jasidih Railway Station for your onward journey.
